author: reek
body: A bitwise operation whose left side is a let-bound local and whose right side is a literal, in a function small enough to be emitted without a frame.

author: reek
body: **These are answers and not a shape on purpose.** The fix takes the I-type immediate form, so the register form is no longer emitted for these operands at all -- but a lane that lowers them some third way is equally welcome, provided it computes the same numbers.
